body:
## What it does

This one reads two things side by side: the openly published ranking source behind the For You timeline, and how your own recent posts are actually performing at this moment. Out of that it makes a call on the next move — start something fresh, quote another account, or wait for a better window.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @UziObi shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
